answer.rationale: Verify the low-cost vendor’s prior onboarding and invoicing performance, plus the archived evidence that a second source protected continuity during shortage. With the line at 94% of committed volume and no buffer, adding the low-cost vendor as a guarded second source limits single-source delivery risk while testing whether its quoted economics can support the mandated reduction. The 18% savings and capacity impact remain uncertain, so avoid an immediate broad rollout.
